---
title: Design Tokens
description: The typed token groups that Theme resolves into --puzzle-* CSS custom properties.
---

All of Puzzle's design values live in a single typed `ThemeTokens` object. `Theme` merges your overrides into the defaults and emits every value as a `--puzzle-*` CSS custom property. Components never hardcode design values; they reference these variables.

## Overriding tokens

Pass a deep-partial `tokens` object to `Theme`. Anything you omit keeps its default. Unknown token names throw a `TypeError`, so typos are caught immediately:

```tsx
<Theme
  tokens={{
    radius: { md: "0.5rem" },
    spacing: { 4: "1.125rem" },
    motion: { normal: "240ms" },
  }}
>
  <App />
</Theme>
```

Every value is validated as a safe CSS value before it is injected.

## Token groups

### Spacing

Emitted as `--puzzle-space-{key}`.

| Key   | Default    |
| ----- | ---------- |
| `0`   | `0`        |
| `px`  | `1px`      |
| `0.5` | `0.125rem` |
| `1`   | `0.25rem`  |
| `1.5` | `0.375rem` |
| `2`   | `0.5rem`   |
| `3`   | `0.75rem`  |
| `4`   | `1rem`     |
| `5`   | `1.25rem`  |
| `6`   | `1.5rem`   |
| `8`   | `2rem`     |
| `10`  | `2.5rem`   |
| `12`  | `3rem`     |
| `16`  | `4rem`     |
| `20`  | `5rem`     |
| `24`  | `6rem`     |

### Radius

Emitted as `--puzzle-radius-{key}`.

| Key    | Default    |
| ------ | ---------- |
| `none` | `0`        |
| `sm`   | `0.125rem` |
| `md`   | `0.375rem` |
| `lg`   | `0.5rem`   |
| `xl`   | `0.75rem`  |
| `2xl`  | `1rem`     |
| `3xl`  | `1.5rem`   |
| `full` | `9999px`   |

### Shadows

Emitted as `--puzzle-shadow-{key}` with keys `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, and `xl`.

### Elevation

A finer-grained elevation scale emitted as `--puzzle-elevation-{key}` with keys `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6`, `8`, `12`, `16`, and `24`. Use elevation for layered surfaces such as cards, menus, and dialogs.

### Borders

| Token                 | CSS variable                   | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- |
| `borders.width`       | `--puzzle-border-width`        | `1px`   |
| `borders.widthStrong` | `--puzzle-border-width-strong` | `2px`   |
| `borders.style`       | `--puzzle-border-style`        | `solid` |

### Layout

| Token              | CSS variable               | Default |
| ------------------ | -------------------------- | ------- |
| `layout.container` | `--puzzle-container-width` | `80rem` |
| `layout.content`   | `--puzzle-content-width`   | `64rem` |
| `layout.prose`     | `--puzzle-prose-width`     | `65ch`  |

A responsive gutter, `--puzzle-container-gutter: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 6rem)`, is provided by the base stylesheet.

### Breakpoints

Emitted as `--puzzle-breakpoint-{key}` with keys `tablet` (`768px`), `desktop` (`1024px`), and `hd` (`1440px`). See [Breakpoints](/docs/theme/breakpoints) for the JavaScript constants.

### Overlays

| Token                   | CSS variable                     | Default             |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `overlays.backdrop`     | `--puzzle-overlay-backdrop`      | `rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)` |
| `overlays.backdropBlur` | `--puzzle-overlay-backdrop-blur` | `2px`               |

### Motion

| Token                   | CSS variable               | Default                      |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `motion.fast`           | `--puzzle-duration-fast`   | `120ms`                      |
| `motion.normal`         | `--puzzle-duration-normal` | `200ms`                      |
| `motion.slow`           | `--puzzle-duration-slow`   | `320ms`                      |
| `motion.easingStandard` | `--puzzle-easing-standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` |
| `motion.easingIn`       | `--puzzle-easing-in`       | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)` |
| `motion.easingOut`      | `--puzzle-easing-out`      | `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)` |

### Z-index

Emitted as `--puzzle-z-index-{key}`.

| Key          | Default |
| ------------ | ------- |
| `base`       | `0`     |
| `dropdown`   | `100`   |
| `sticky`     | `200`   |
| `navigation` | `250`   |
| `overlay`    | `300`   |
| `modal`      | `400`   |
| `popover`    | `500`   |
| `toast`      | `600`   |
| `tooltip`    | `700`   |

### Colors and typography

Color scheme tokens are documented on the [Colors](/docs/theme/colors) page, and typography scales and roles on the [Typography & Fonts](/docs/theme/typography) page.

## Using tokens in CSS

Reference the variables directly in component styles:

```css
.my-panel {
  background: var(--puzzle-color-surface);
  border: var(--puzzle-border-width) var(--puzzle-border-style)
    var(--puzzle-color-border);
  border-radius: var(--puzzle-radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--puzzle-elevation-2);
  padding: var(--puzzle-space-4);
  transition: box-shadow var(--puzzle-duration-normal)
    var(--puzzle-easing-standard);
}
```

Prefer semantic tokens over raw values so your styles respond to theme changes, token overrides, and light/dark mode automatically.
